correctness.rationale: The explicitly defined complex has exactly 331 nonempty faces. A deterministic 160-pair acyclic matching leaves one 0-cell, five 2-cells and five 3-cells. All integral elementary cancellation pivots are units and the final Morse differential is zero. Hurewicz then proves the wedge homotopy type, not merely ranks. Exact rational ranks 14,61,79,6 and signed group-chain character calculations establish H2 as sign-twisted point permutation and H3 as Specht(3,2), with seven-class checks. Finite quotient invariant arguments over Q are valid. Reproducible standalone scripts and outputs included.

value.rationale: This is a complete integral homotopy classification and two-degree equivariant rational homology calculation for a canonical highly symmetric non-bipartite cubic graph, not a routine example of the complete-graph matching-complex formula. The distinct 5-dimensional modules explain a mathematically natural distinction between A5 and S5 orbit-space rational homology. All claimed invariants arise from the entire natural matching complex rather than an artificial parameter slice.
